meta.promptText: Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye konsa moisturizer kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Indian winters mein **rich, fragrance-free cream moisturizer** kharidein—especially agar skin tight, flaky ya itchy hoti hai. Label par **ceramides + glycerin/hyaluronic acid**, aur bahut dry skin ke liye **shea butter ya squalane** dekhein.[1][3]

**Achhe options:**
- **Normal-to-dry skin:** Cetaphil DAM, CeraVe Moisturising Cream, Bioderma Atoderm Creme  
- **Very dry/sensitive skin:** Physiogel Daily Moisture Therapy Cream, Bioderma Atoderm Intensive Baume  
- **Budget option:** Venusia Max Cream ya Re’equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser  
- **Bahut flaky patches:** Raat mein moisturizer ke upar **thin layer petroleum jelly** lagayein.[5]

Face wash ke turant baad **thodi damp skin par** moisturizer lagayein; subah sunscreen bhi use karein. Garam paani, harsh soap aur scrubs avoid karein, kyunki ye dryness badha sakte hain.[3][10] Pehle patch test karein; jalan, redness ya persistent itching ho to dermatologist se milें.
